summary_en: INEST, Inc. authorized acquisition of up to 146,100 shares (2.0% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥100 million via market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 10, 2026 to March 31, 2027, to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
INEST, Inc. announced on November 9, 2026 that its Board of Directors has resolved to acquire treasury stock under the provisions of the Companies Act. The company will repurchase up to 146,100 ordinary shares, representing 2.0% of outstanding shares (calculated based on 7,283,347 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026), for a maximum aggregate amount of ¥100 million.

The shares will be acquired through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 10, 2026 through March 31, 2027. The company stated that this repurchase program is intended to enhance capital efficiency and strengthen shareholder returns as part of its dynamic capital policy, while supporting sustainable growth and medium-to-long-term enhancement of enterprise value through growth investments aimed at business expansion.
